title: Binary Tree Vertical Order Traversal
description:
Given the root of a binary tree, return its vertical order traversal. Columns are ordered from left to right; within each column, nodes are ordered from top to bottom. Nodes in the same row and column are ordered from left to right, matching breadth-first traversal order.

## Examples

```text
Input: root = [3,9,20,null,null,15,7]
Output: [[9],[3,15],[20],[7]]
```

```text
Input: root = [3,9,8,4,0,1,7]
Output: [[4],[9],[3,0,1],[8],[7]]
```

## Constraints

- The number of nodes is in `[0, 100]`
- `-100 <= Node.val <= 100`
